# Port Credit Physio and Rehab

> Port Credit Physio and Rehab is a multidisciplinary physiotherapy and rehabilitation clinic located in Port Credit, Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. The clinic provides physiotherapy, registered massage therapy, chiropractic care, acupuncture, sports rehabilitation, and post-motor-vehicle-accident (MVA) recovery for patients across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA). Online booking is handled through JaneApp at portcreditphysioandrehab.janeapp.com.

Port Credit Physio and Rehab serves patients in Port Credit, Mississauga, Oakville, Etobicoke, and the wider western GTA. The clinic accepts most extended health insurance plans (direct billing available), WSIB claims, and motor vehicle accident (MVA) auto-insurance claims. All treatments are delivered by licensed and regulated Ontario healthcare professionals registered with the College of Physiotherapists of Ontario (CPO), the College of Massage Therapists of Ontario (CMTO), and other relevant regulatory colleges. ## Services

- [Physiotherapy](https://www.portcreditphysio.ca/services/physiotherapy/): Assessment and treatment of musculoskeletal, neurological, and post-surgical conditions by registered physiotherapists
- [Registered Massage Therapy (RMT)](https://www.portcreditphysio.ca/services/massage-therapy/): Deep tissue, Swedish, and therapeutic massage by CMTO-registered massage therapists - receipts eligible for insurance reimbursement
- [Acupuncture and Dry Needling](https://www.portcreditphysio.ca/services/acupuncture/): Traditional Chinese acupuncture and Western dry needling for pain and functional recovery
- [Sports Rehabilitation](https://www.portcreditphysio.ca/services/sports-rehab/): Injury recovery, return-to-sport programs, and performance optimization for recreational and competitive athletes
- [Motor Vehicle Accident (MVA) Rehabilitation](https://www.portcreditphysio.ca/services/mva-rehab/): SABS-compliant treatment plans, direct billing to auto insurers, and coordination with adjusters and lawyers
- [WSIB Rehabilitation](https://www.portcreditphysio.ca/services/wsib/): Workplace injury rehabilitation with direct WSIB billing and return-to-work planning


## Conditions treated

- Lower back pain and sciatica
- Neck pain, whiplash, and cervical strain
- Shoulder injuries (rotator cuff, frozen shoulder, impingement)
- Knee injuries (ACL/MCL sprains, meniscus tears, patellofemoral pain)
- Hip pain and post-hip-replacement rehab
- Tennis elbow, golfer's elbow, and repetitive strain injuries
- Plantar fasciitis and foot/ankle pain
- Post-surgical rehabilitation (knee, hip, shoulder, spinal)
- Sports injuries and overuse conditions
- Motor vehicle accident injuries (soft-tissue, whiplash, concussion)
- Workplace injuries (WSIB-covered)
- Chronic pain and postural dysfunction
- Arthritis and joint pain management
- Vertigo and balance disorders

## Insurance and payment

- Direct billing to most major extended health insurance providers, including Manulife, Sun Life, Canada Life (formerly Great-West Life), Green Shield Canada, Desjardins, Empire Life, Industrial Alliance, Blue Cross, and Johnson
- WSIB - direct billing for approved workplace injury claims
- Motor Vehicle Accident (MVA) claims - direct billing to auto insurers under Ontario's Statutory Accident Benefits Schedule (SABS)
- OHIP - generally does not cover physiotherapy for adults; select seniors (65+) and post-hospital-discharge patients may qualify through OHIP-funded programs [CONFIRM if clinic is an OHIP-funded site]
- Payment methods: debit, credit card, cash, and e-transfer
- Receipts issued for all self-pay visits for personal reimbursement

## Frequently asked questions

- Do I need a doctor's referral for physiotherapy in Ontario? No. Physiotherapists in Ontario are primary healthcare providers - you can book directly without a referral. However, some insurance plans require a physician's referral for reimbursement; check with your insurer.
- Is physiotherapy covered by OHIP? For most adults, no. OHIP covers physiotherapy only for specific groups (seniors 65+, post-hospital-discharge patients, ODSP/Ontario Works recipients) at designated OHIP-funded clinics. Most patients use extended health insurance or self-pay.
- How long is a typical appointment? Initial physiotherapy assessments are typically 45–60 minutes. Follow-up treatments are usually 30 minutes. Massage therapy sessions range from 30 to 90 minutes. [CONFIRM exact durations]
- Do you accept new MVA patients? Yes. Port Credit Physio and Rehab treats patients recovering from motor vehicle accidents under Ontario's SABS framework, with direct billing to auto insurers.
- Do you offer virtual physiotherapy? [CONFIRM whether telehealth/virtual physio sessions are available]

## Regulatory and professional standards

- Physiotherapists registered with the [College of Physiotherapists of Ontario (CPO)](https://www.collegept.org/)
- Registered Massage Therapists registered with the [College of Massage Therapists of Ontario (CMTO)](https://www.cmto.com/)
- Chiropractors registered with the [College of Chiropractors of Ontario (CCO)](https://www.cco.on.ca/)
- All patient information handled in accordance with Ontario's [Personal Health Information Protection Act (PHIPA)](https://www.ontario.ca/laws/statute/04p03)
